description:
AgentConfig specifies additional configuration for the OpenShift agent-based installer. It is consumed alongside install-config.yaml during cluster installation and is NOT a live Kubernetes resource.

Source types:
  https://github.com/openshift/installer/blob/main/pkg/types/agent/agent_config_type.go
  https://github.com/openshift/installer/blob/main/pkg/types/baremetal/rootdevice.go
  https://github.com/openshift/assisted-service/blob/master/api/v1beta1/nmstate_config_types.go

apiVersion.description: APIVersion for the AgentConfig resource. Must be "v1beta1".

kind.description: Kind of the resource. Must be "AgentConfig".

rendezvousIP.description: IP address of the rendezvous host — the node that runs the bootstrap workloads during installation. Must be reachable by all other hosts.

bootArtifactsBaseURL.description: Base URL used for downloading boot artifacts (kernel, initrd, rootfs) when using user-provided infrastructure. Must be an http/https URL.

minimalISO.description: When true, a minimal ISO that does not contain the rootfs will be generated. Defaults to false (full ISO). Automatically set to true for External platform installations.

additionalNTPSources.description: List of additional NTP sources (hostname or IP address) added to all cluster hosts. These are merged with any NTP sources configured via other means.

hosts.description: Per-host configuration overrides. At least one interface must be specified per host entry so the correct physical node can be identified by MAC address.

name.description: Name of the cluster / config object.

namespace.description: Namespace (optional, typically omitted for installer configs).

AgentConfigHost.description: Host defines per-host configuration for agent-based installation.

role.description: Role of this host in the cluster. Valid values are "master" (control-plane) and "worker". If omitted the installer assigns roles automatically.

rootDeviceHints.description: Hints used to identify the disk on which the OS will be installed. Only one of the hint fields needs to match.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces present on this host, used to match the host by MAC address and to rename interfaces in the NMState networkConfig. At least one interface must be specified.

networkConfig.description: NMState-format network configuration applied to this host. See https://nmstate.io/examples.html for examples. The value is a free-form YAML/JSON object matching the NMState operational-state schema.

RootDeviceHints.description: RootDeviceHints holds hints for identifying the storage device on which the OS image will be installed. Mirrors baremetal.RootDeviceHints from the OpenShift installer.

deviceName.description: Linux device path such as "/dev/sda" or a "/dev/disk/by-path/…" path. Must start with /dev/. Exact match.

hctl.description: SCSI bus address in H:C:T:L notation (e.g. "0:0:0:0"). Exact match.

model.description: Vendor-specific device model identifier. Substring match.

vendor.description: Name of the device vendor / manufacturer. Substring match.

minSizeGigabytes.description: Minimum required disk size in Gigabytes.

wwnWithExtension.description: WWN with vendor extension appended. Exact match.

wwnVendorExtension.description: Unique vendor storage identifier. Exact match.

rotational.description: Set to true to require a spinning (HDD) device; false for non-rotating (SSD/NVMe).

NetworkInterface.description: Interface maps a logical NIC name to a physical MAC address, used to match and rename interfaces when applying the NMState networkConfig.

name.description: Logical NIC name as it should appear inside the NMState network configuration.

macAddress.description: MAC address of the interface on the physical host. Format: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX (hex pairs separated by colons).
